name: project-templates
description: A Copier template that starts Python, TypeScript, Rust, Go and Docker repos, secure by default and kept current by a weekly update PR. Research code comes citable, with CITATION.cff, a Zenodo DOI and a Software Heritage archive. Its data-pipeline kind builds a dataset from public sources where every row says which download it came from, and the web-app kind adds legal pages and an accessibility statement.
